Pattern: a hard-fought + N (match, victory)
Examples: It was a hard-fought draw in the mud. | A hard-fought victory is worth two easy ones.

Pattern: take part in + N; không tách được
Examples: Nine hundred took part in the first year. | She takes part in everything the club organises.

Pattern: warm down; không có tân ngữ
Examples: They warm down with a walk around the pitch. | Nobody warms down when the bus is waiting.

Pattern: line up; line up for + N
Examples: The teams lined up in silence. | Nine hundred runners lined up at dawn.

Pattern: send off + sb hoặc send + sb + off; tách được
Examples: He was sent off in the first half. | They sent two players off in nine minutes.

Pattern: bring on + sb hoặc bring + sb + on; tách được
Examples: The trainer brought on a seventeen-year-old. | They brought him on with twenty minutes left.

Pattern: sit out + N hoặc sit + N + out; tách được
Examples: She sat out the whole second half. | He sat out nine weeks with a sprain.

Pattern: cheer on + sb hoặc cheer + sb + on; tách được
Examples: The village cheered on its own team for nine decades. | They cheered her on up the final hill.

Pattern: come first; come first in + N
Examples: She came first in her age group. | Coming first mattered less than finishing.

Definition: lấy lại dáng và thể lực
Pattern: shape up; không có tân ngữ
Examples: He shaped up over one winter of swimming. | The squad shaped up after three weeks of pre-season.

Pattern: pair up; pair up with + sb
Examples: Beginners pair up with an experienced member. | They paired up for the doubles and won.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; hold/a + sports day
Examples: Sports day is the only race some children ever run. | The school sports day was rained off twice.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; organise/a + fun run
Examples: The fun run attracted nine hundred entries. | A fun run raises money and nobody's heart rate.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; take part in/a + charity run
Examples: The charity run raised enough for the minibus. | She has done the same charity run for nine years.

Definition: buổi tập chung của câu lạc bộ
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a + club night + runs
Examples: Club night is Tuesday and Thursday, whatever the weather. | Nine members turned up to club night in the snow.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; run/a + youth team
Examples: The youth team feeds the first team and the local schools. | Nine youth teams play on the same afternoon.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a + veteran player + leads
Examples: A veteran player of forty-two held the defence together. | Veteran players run the club when they stop playing.

Pattern: go the distance
Examples: She went the distance in her first marathon. | Nine of the entrants went the distance in that heat.

Definition: sức lực hồi lại (sau lúc đuối)
Pattern: get/find + a second wind
Examples: She found a second wind at the ninth kilometre. | He got a second wind and finished strongly.

Pattern: be + on the ball
Examples: The goalkeeper was on the ball all afternoon. | She is on the ball in every meeting too.

Pattern: throw in the towel
Examples: He threw in the towel after the fourth round. | They refused to throw in the towel at nine down.

Definition: thay đổi luật chơi giữa chừng
Pattern: move the goalposts
Examples: The funders moved the goalposts twice in one year. | Moving the goalposts makes any target meaningless.

Definition: cơ hội công bằng để thắng
Pattern: give sb/have + a sporting chance
Examples: Give the younger ones a sporting chance. | They had a sporting chance until the sending off.

Pattern: be + neck and neck
Examples: The two clubs were neck and neck until April. | They finished neck and neck after nine kilometres.

Pattern: be + par for the course
Examples: Rain in April is par for the course here. | A late kick-off is par for the course on that ground.

Pattern: jump the gun
Examples: Two runners jumped the gun and the start was recalled. | The announcement jumped the gun by a fortnight.

Pattern: raise the bar
Examples: Her performance raised the bar for the whole club. | They raised the bar and nine members left.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; have/enjoy + home advantage
Examples: Home advantage on that sloping pitch is real. | They had home advantage and lost anyway.
